messages:
sre-oncall: noticing elevated apiserver read latency in eu-central1 since ~08:12UTC. controller-manager leader flips frequent, gpu-provisioner backlog growing. Customers hitting slow attaches.

anil: looking into logs now. any disk or network errors?

maria: nvme hosts show fsync stalls and blk errors. quick snippet from host logs:
```
Apr 07 08:11:58 host kernel: INFO: task etcd:2456 blocked for more than 120 seconds
Apr 07 08:12:01 host kernel: blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 1234567
Apr 07 08:12:12 host kernel: fsync: 120ms
```

chris: metrics: gpu-provisioner queue ~2100 pending, provision rate fell from 45/s to ~8/s. short-term cost bump if we replace instances rapidly.

infra-bot: ALERT: apiserver_read_latency_p95 eu-central1 >= 520ms

anil: yeah, etcd WAL fsync blocking apiserver reads -> controller-manager lease renewals failing. leader election churn explains ctrlmgr log spam about lease timeouts.

maria: controller-manager logs: "failed to renew lease: operation timed out" and "lost connection to apiserver".

chris: mitigation options: 1) throttle onboarding/provision bursts, 2) divert provisioning to west-eu, 3) nudge etcd leader to a healthier host, 4) increase apiserver inflight limits.

sre-oncall: prioritize quick fixes. Maria/Anil do 1+3. Chris prep diversion plan. I'll handle customer notices.

anil: applied etcd WAL retry tweak (backoff 300ms->600ms) to reduce fsync fail churn. Rolling config to etcd statefulset now.

maria: increasing controller-manager leader-election timeouts (lease 30s->60s, renew 20s->40s) and will stagger restart across shards.

infra-bot: INFO: running `kubectl get pods -n gpu-provisioning -o wide`

infra-bot: ```
NAME                      READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
gpu-provisioner-0         1/1     Running            0          18d
gpu-provisioner-1         0/1     CrashLoopBackOff    12         3h
gpu-node-launcher-xyz     0/1     Pending             0          15m
```

chris: kicking off west-eu canary (5 nodes) and labeling eu-central nodes "provisioning=lowprio" so scheduler prefers west-eu for new GPU capacity. patch ready to apply.

anil: also requesting ops to cordon one NVMe host for immediate health check and to consider promoting a healthier etcd follower as leader.

maria: temporarily bumping apiserver flags --max-requests-inflight and --max-mutating-requests-inflight by +20 to reduce rejected calls from controllers. Rolling safely.

chris: cost impact FYI 11 short-term west-eu Dedicated nodes add ~6-8% to GPU opex this hour. tagging allocations for finance.

sre-oncall: monitoring p95; if re-spike -> full incident. For now ETA to stable ~15-25m. Post-mortem TODOs: NVMe firmware check, provision higher-io etcd leader types, add rate-limiter admission for bursty gpu requests, run cost analysis for diversion.

maria: noted. will open follow-up ticket and assign action owners.

sre-oncall: thanks everyone, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
